g.text: Modal, permitted by 11.3.4 as a single confirmation.
Unsaved form input survives it (11.3.5): the form state
lives in the ReportSite component, not in the modal.
Self-transitions are new in this version.
or job action changes entity state without changing screen,
so it is drawn as a transition from a state to itself rather
than omitted. Every one names the controller that performs
it, and every status change reaches
The four §11.4 sub-states — loading, empty, error, stale —
apply to every state above** and are held as one LoadState
value per screen component. Entering one is not a navigation
transition and does not change the route, so 11.3.2 still
now has a return path; Moderation Queue gained the one it never had,
and Work Order Create returns to whichever of its three entry screens
it was opened from rather than always to Cluster Detail. Not Authorised
and Not Found now carry distinct URLs. All four defects were inherited
from the Lab 2 map and survived the first refinement pass; an
v0.9 additions. 11.3.20: the Report a Site screen requires a
pest type before its other fields activate, because the pest
type decides which fields 5.1.16 makes mandatory.
11.3.21: the Report Review screen offers REFERRAL, not work-order
creation, when the pest class is Wildlife (8.1.14, 8.1.15).
